key_insight: QAccCert shows that quantum software engineering can combine FPGA control and AI-guided search to certify entanglement efficiently via CHSH inequality violation.
engineering_relevance: The work offers a practical QSE-style blueprint for building hybrid quantum certification systems that may scale to noisy NISQ hardware.
method: Implements a hybrid certification framework for quantum devices.
Uses CHSH inequality violation to test entanglement in Qiskit AerSimulator.
Applies LLM-guided optimization to explore parameter space more effectively than random search.
evidence_signal: In simulation, the approach reached 99.94% of the theoretical CHSH maximum of 2√2, indicating near-optimal certification performance.
watch_item: The results are currently limited to idealized simulations, so real hardware noise, decoherence, and FPGA integration overhead remain open implementation risks.
paper_title: Quantum Software Engineering in Practice: FPGA and AI Integration for Quantum Certification
